disclaimer: Research index only; not legal advice or production policy. An official landing page is discovery evidence, not a substitute for the exact operative instrument. No source is production-activated by this registry.

sources.authority: Central Pollution Control Board / Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
sources.title: Centralised Online Portal for Solid Waste Management
sources.applicability: Resolve per ULB/RLB, BWG, facility, waste stream, jurisdiction and reporting period.
sources.notes: Portal states SWM Rules 2026 notified 27 January 2026 and effective 1 April 2026.

sources.authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
sources.title: Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026
sources.applicability: Check the exact rule, transitional provisions, actor, stream and jurisdiction before calculating obligations.
sources.notes: Official PDF states supersession of SWM Rules 2016 subject to things done or omitted before supersession.

sources.title: Plastic Packaging EPR Portal
sources.applicability: PIBO/recycler/processor role, packaging category, registration, financial year and current amendments must be resolved.
sources.notes: Do not hard-code targets from the landing page.

sources.title: Common EPR Portal
sources.applicability: Resolve the applicable EPR stream and current operative rules; do not assume this portal covers every stream.
sources.notes: Portal availability does not prove a filing, certificate, transfer or acceptance.

sources.title: Battery Waste EPR Portal
sources.applicability: Battery category, producer/recycler role, registration and current targets require separate rule-version review.
sources.notes: Do not conflate battery EPR with plastic, e-waste or SWM-only obligations.

sources.title: E-Waste EPR Portal
sources.applicability: Verify current E-Waste Management Rules and amendments, actor role and portal process.
sources.notes: Separate from plastic packaging, batteries and SWM.

sources.title: Waste Tyre EPR Portal
sources.applicability: Verify current waste-tyre rules, actor role, registration, targets and certificates.
sources.notes: Do not share accounting rules across EPR streams without legal basis.

sources.title: Used Oil EPR Portal
sources.applicability: Verify current used-oil EPR rules, target and certificate accounting.
sources.notes: Keep used oil separate from other EPR streams.

sources.authority: Bureau of Energy Efficiency / Ministry of Power
sources.title: Carbon Market document register
sources.applicability: Select compliance versus offset mechanism and effective procedure by entity/project and period.
sources.notes: Register includes final document families and draft consultations; document status must be classified individually.

sources.authority: Bureau of Energy Efficiency / Ministry of Power
sources.title: Detailed Procedure for Offset Mechanism and Methodologies
sources.applicability: Project start date, sector, approved methodology, additionality/regulatory surplus, monitoring, validation, verification and double counting.
sources.notes: Before applying, check BEE's current document register for amendments or a superseding procedure.

sources.authority: Bureau of Energy Efficiency / Ministry of Power
sources.title: Approved methodologies and tools under Offset Mechanism
sources.applicability: Only current approved methodology/version and sector can be considered for a project; do not infer eligibility from waste activity alone.
sources.notes: Page showed last updated 7 July 2026 at review; current listing included BM WA03.001, BM WA03.002 and BM WA03.003.

sources.authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India
sources.title: Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reporting by listed entities
sources.applicability: Determine listed-entity status, reporting period and current SEBI/LODR requirements.
sources.notes: Not a universal reporting mandate for every MSME, municipality, recycler or project.

sources.authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India
sources.title: BRSR Core framework for assurance and ESG disclosures for value chain
sources.applicability: Phased listed-entity BRSR Core schedule; apply later SEBI changes and current reporting-period rules.
sources.notes: Original glide path reached top 1000 listed entities for FY 2026-27; do not apply the original value-chain timetable without subsequent updates.

sources.authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India
sources.title: Measures to facilitate ease of doing business with respect to ESG value-chain disclosures
sources.applicability: Apply value-chain disclosure and assurance rules by reporting period and listed-entity scope.
sources.notes: Do not generalize value-chain relief to the core BRSR applicability of the listed entity.

sources.authority: Integrity Council for the Voluntary Carbon Market
sources.title: Core Carbon Principles
sources.applicability: Supplemental integrity benchmark only; never substitute for Indian statutory requirements or CCTS eligibility/issuance.
sources.notes: Keep voluntary integrity review separate from legal compliance and government certificate status.
